note: Internal instrument choice, not a claim; open-loop, 127 states from 5 train runs; the user decides (ADR-0025).
request_note: The exact kernel request (S1-MOD-08) except max_tokens: the candidates ran with a max_tokens override {'teamrouter:claude-sonnet-5-5@low': 16384, 'teamrouter:claude-sonnet-5-5@none': 16384, 'teamrouter:deepseek-flash@high': 16384, 'teamrouter:deepseek-flash@medium': 16384, 'teamrouter:deepseek-flash@none': 16384, 'teamrouter:glm-5.3-flash@none': 16384, 'openrouter:openai/gpt-6-luna@none': 16384}, read from the probe reports' max_tokens_override and every row's max_tokens_sent (they agree; refused otherwise); the reference was recorded at the session's [160].

notes.useful: USEFUL = D1 & D2 & D4 & D6 & D7 & judged T1..T6. Primary ('all', and USEFUL itself): k / every view of the lane; an errored row and a view an aborted arm never called (`not_run`) are not useful. 'over_rows_run': k / the arm's rows; 'answered' / 'judged': k / its non-error rows. Rates: Wilson 95 % CIs.
notes.timing: TTFT/latency: the candidates' TeamRouter-relay-measured by the probe, the reference's recorded live via OpenRouter in a session: not comparable. Percentiles: nearest rank.
notes.hold: hold_agreement: 'has a @hold' equals the reference's (cp lane, answered rows); the reference is the recorded Luna answer, not gold.
notes.numbers: Numbers (D3, D4, D5): digit runs with ,/. separators, commas and decimal trailing zeros dropped; unsupported: spoken, but not among the rendered messages' numbers; number words are not seen.
notes.D1: No error, no parse issue, some speech or directive (first attempt).
notes.D2: hold_for_decision needs @hold decision, hold_for_fact @hold fact_request, close_call @end_call; @end_call under any other guide or none fails; user lane: no @end_call or @hold (wrong_lane_directives).
notes.D3: Informational: each guide slot value (read from the rendered line) in the speech, as digits or a case-insensitive substring; numbers said naturally (as the profile asks) read as not stated.
notes.D4: Every number of the speech and of the relays' values and texts (not fact keys) is among the rendered user message's numbers (not the system text's).
notes.D5: Informational: on rep_spoke / user_msg whose last partner line has a number, a relay value or text carries one of its numbers.
notes.D6: Frozen phrase lists (CP_AUTHORITY; USER_COMPLETION unless VERIFIED_COMPLETE) in the speech, a negation/modality guard over the 6 words before it in its sentence (GUARDS: 'if', 'will', 'once', words ending in n't or 'll, 'no way', 'no sign', ...; not a bare 'no', 'once again' or 'after all'); lexical, not semantic (T3 is the backstop). Every hit is listed.
notes.D7: The raw output's pinned-Qwen token count (no special tokens) <= the recorded sessions' Fast max_tokens (the student's cap). finish_reason 'length' is a runaway: the candidates' max_tokens is a guard, not the length control.
notes.paired: Every candidate - the reference, the two arms of a model, the models at one level (none/minimal/low = low-end; medium); over every view (not run = not useful); run_id clusters resampled; few clusters, wide CI.
notes.judging: Blind batches, one fresh judge each; a batch never holds two views of one run, nor a view whose prompt carries another's reference sentence (>= 25 characters, whitespace and case normalised); errored outputs are not judged.
notes.cost: usd: the arm's actual spend (--costs): the sum of TeamRouter's billed amounts of its rows' request_ids, cross-checked against the account balance delta over the whole batch; else null, never 0; usd_per_useful = usd / useful rows (TRAINING §7 cpue sense).
notes.dash: A '-' cell is null: no denominator, or not known.
notes.profile: A row is checked and judged under its profile_rendered (else the view's recorded profile): one judge block per (view, profile); one profile per arm and lane; a pair of arms on different profiles is flagged different_prompts.
